author: Slidebean
description:
Claude can now click, scroll, and run tasks on your computer.

Not just chat.
Act.

This is the shift to agentic AI from answers → to execution.

If connectors fail, it takes over your screen.

The future isn’t AI that talks.
It’s AI that does.

title: AI just started using your computer
